name: Theremin
noAudio: Sound isn’t available in this browser
snapHint.free: Any pitch between notes — like a violin or a fretless neck. Playing in tune is up to your ear.
snapHint.magnet: The sound is pulled to the nearest note, but you can still glide smoothly between notes. Good for melodies and glissandos.
snapHint.note: Only notes of the scale sound; moving between them uses the chosen glide time.
about: Played with hands in front of the camera: one hand sets the pitch, the other the effects and volume.
hint.right: Right hand — pitch: higher hand, higher note. Left hand — effects: open palm is sound, a fist is silence; higher — more space; turning the wrist — tone; tilting forward or back — vibrato; closer to the camera — drive; palm edge-on — tremolo; a pinch holds the effects.
hint.left: Left hand — pitch: higher hand, higher note. Right hand — effects: open palm is sound, a fist is silence; higher — more space; turning the wrist — tone; tilting forward or back — vibrato; closer to the camera — drive; palm edge-on — tremolo; a pinch holds the effects.
privacy: The camera is processed only on this device: the image is neither stored nor sent anywhere.
err.denied: No access to the camera. Permission is granted in the device settings.
err.model: Hand tracking could not be loaded.
charHint: Pitch hand near the frame edge — brighter sound, near the middle — softer.
fxHint: A preset sets constant effects; the effects hand adds its own on top.
camHint: Without the image only the note scale and hands are shown. “Start camera at once” — after the first start the camera turns on by itself when the theremin opens.
calSoon: The effects hand position will be remembered in 2 seconds
calNo: The effects hand is not visible — position not remembered
calAuto: Neutral position of the effects hand remembered
calHint: Turn, tilt, palm rotation and distance to the camera are measured from a neutral position: comfortable, palm towards the camera. It is remembered automatically when the hand first appears; the button above remembers it again. A pinch holds the effects so the hand can rest; another pinch releases them. Volume always stays live.
chordHint: Chords: 1–5 extended fingers are degrees I–V; thumb to pinky is VI, thumb to ring finger is VII (sign language numbers); palm to the camera is major, back of the hand is minor; a fist is silence; hand height sets the chord register. The “OK” sign (thumb and index in a ring) switches solo and chords.
cqHint.hand: Palm to the camera — a major chord, back of the hand — minor, on any degree.
cqHint.key: Chords follow the key (in major: I, IV, V major; ii, iii, vi minor; vii diminished); the back of the hand gives the opposite quality.
help.what: Played with the hands in front of the camera, without touching.
help.1: Right hand — pitch: higher hand, higher note. The “OK” sign switches solo and chords.
help.2: Chords: 1–5 fingers are degrees I–V, thumb to pinky is VI, to ring finger is VII; palm — major, back of the hand — minor.
help.3: Left hand — effects: a fist is silence, higher — space, wrist turn — tone, tilt — vibrato; a pinch holds the effects.
help.4: The camera is processed only on the device and turns off when the window closes.
help.tip: Even light and whole palms in view make tracking more accurate.
hudHint: “Quiet” keeps only the note scale at the edge and a glow on the palms; “None” leaves the clean camera picture. A double tap on the screen switches.
csHint: Pads are the sounds of the Drone module: the chord fades in softly and sustains. The effects hand changes volume, brightness, vibrato and tremolo.
ctiltHint: Upright — triad. Lean outward (like a clock hand, away from the body) — seventh: C7, Cm7, Cø for diminished. Lean inward — Cmaj7 for major, diminished for minor. Fingers forward to the camera — sus4, back — sus2.
harmHint: Fingers of the pitch hand add voices to the melody in the chord key. Palm, fist or one finger — melody only. Tilting the hand either way applies the chosen effect.
hstHint.classic: 2 — third above, 3 — triad, 4 — chorale below, thumb to pinky — octave below, to ring — sixth below.
hstHint.jazz: 2 — block chord under the melody, 3 — fourths, 4 — upper structure a tone higher, thumb to pinky — fifth and bass, to ring — shell with bass.
hstHint.rock: 2 — fifth below, 3 — power (fifth and octave), 4 — octaves up and down, thumb to pinky — fourth below, to ring — fifth and octave below.
hstHint.film: 2 — parallel major triad, 3 — minor, 4 — open fifths, thumb to pinky — sus2, to ring — major seventh.
